title: downloadFileWithRedirects has no timeout and ignores response stream failures, so packaging can hang indefinitely
test: tests/packageApp.test.js: 'downloadFileWithRedirects rejects within connectTimeoutMs when the server never sends headers', 'downloadFileWithRedirects applies the connect timeout to the hop after a redirect', 'downloadFileWithRedirects rejects within idleTimeoutMs when the body stalls and removes the partial file', 'downloadFileWithRedirects rejects when the server destroys the socket mid-body (with a Content-Length)' and '(chunked)', 'downloadFileWithRedirects rejects when the server ends the connection before the whole body arrived', 'downloadFileWithRedirects rejects, instead of throwing, when the destination directory cannot be made', 'downloadFileWithRedirects rejects, instead of throwing, on an unusable redirect target', 'downloadFileWithRedirects rejects when the response stream errors, once, and removes the partial file', 'downloadFileWithRedirects rejects when the response closes without ending', 'downloadFileWithRedirects rejects when the response is aborted'; guards that passed before and after: success, redirect, redirect limit, non-200, steady slow download, file-stream error on a directory destination, plain http refused by the default transport, request error before any response, transport throwing
proof: Each test serves from a local http server through the new injected `get` option (or a fake request/response), uses 300 ms timeouts, and asserts that the promise settles within 4 s and that nothing is left at the destination. On the unchanged code (with only a test hook added so the injected transport reaches it) 11 of the 25 tests in the file failed: the no-headers case, the no-headers-after-a-redirect case, the stalled body, the mid-body socket destroy (Content-Length and chunked), the early FIN and the response closed without 'end' / 'aborted' all failed with 'the download should reject, but it was still pending after 4000 ms' (the promise never settled, as the issue says: pipe() does not end the file when the response closes without 'end', the response 'error' has no listener, and there is no timer); a response stream destroyed with an error failed as an uncaught 'connection reset by peer' (no listener on the response); a destination whose directory cannot be made failed as an uncaught ENOTDIR thrown inside the response callback, and an unparsable Location header as an uncaught 'Invalid URL' from the same callback. After the fix all 25 pass in about 2 s: every request (also after each redirect) arms a connect timer until the headers arrive and an idle timer that restarts on each chunk and each file drain; the response gets 'error', 'aborted' and 'close'-without-'end' handlers, the request an 'error' handler, the file an 'error' handler; one settle-once path destroys the request, response and file, waits for the file handle to close, deletes the partial file and only then rejects. The output of the before run is kept in .arbitra/dev-notes/results/TASK-045-before.txt.
